claim: Phase pruning can be propagated to certified generalized-chi-square tail brackets through a block-norm operator bound, Weyl eigenvalue enclosure, and stochastic ordering.
non_claims: The dual-budget greedy scheduler is certified but not claimed globally optimal.
A small Krylov-transfer budget alone does not guarantee a narrow spectral or p-value bracket.
Incomplete range-core tail bounds may be vacuous; the experiment explicitly records this.
The synthetic tests do not establish biological or clinical performance.
